campuses.title: Munich Campus
campuses.text: Кампус EU Business School в Мюнхене работает с 1991. Расположен в районе Theresienhöhe рядом с Theresienwiese (где проходит Oktoberfest). Современные аудитории, библиотека, study rooms.

paragraphs: EU Business School is a private international business school founded in 1973 in Antwerp, Belgium (originally as European University). Today EU operates campuses in Geneva, Barcelona, Munich and a Digital campus, with around 3,000 students from over 100 nationalities. The Munich campus opened in 1991 and focuses on business education in English for an international cohort.

EU Business School Munich offers BBA, MSc, MBA, Executive MBA and DBA programs across business administration, finance, marketing, entrepreneurship, digital business, sports management, communication and international relations. All programs are taught in English with a strong applied focus and small class sizes.

EU Business School holds ACBSP and IACBE professional accreditation, CEEMAN IQA, Swiss eduQua certification, and is an AACSB member and PRME signatory. The Online MBA was ranked #1 globally by CEO Magazine in 2020 and EU programs feature regularly in QS Global MBA and Master rankings.

Munich is one of Europe's strongest business hubs — home to BMW, Siemens, Allianz, Munich Re, Linde, Microsoft Deutschland, Google Germany and a deep startup ecosystem. The campus is located in the Theresienhöhe district near Theresienwiese and offers students direct access to internships, company visits and the Bavarian business network.
paragraphsRu: EU Business School — частная международная бизнес-школа, основанная в 1973 в Антверпене (Бельгия) под именем European University. Сегодня EU работает в Geneva, Barcelona, Munich и Digital, ~3,000 студентов из 100+ стран. Кампус в Мюнхене открыт в 1991 — бизнес-образование на английском для интернациональной аудитории.

EU Business School Munich предлагает BBA, MSc, MBA, Executive MBA и DBA по направлениям business administration, finance, marketing, entrepreneurship, digital business, sports management, communication, international relations. Все программы на английском, applied focus, малые группы.

EU Business School имеет аккредитации ACBSP и IACBE, CEEMAN IQA, Swiss eduQua, член AACSB и подписант PRME. Online MBA — #1 в мире по версии CEO Magazine (2020), программы EU регулярно попадают в QS Global MBA и Master rankings.

Мюнхен — один из сильнейших бизнес-хабов Европы: BMW, Siemens, Allianz, Munich Re, Linde, Microsoft Deutschland, Google Germany и развитая startup-сцена. Кампус в районе Theresienhöhe рядом с Theresienwiese — прямой доступ к стажировкам, company visits и баварскому бизнес-сообществу.
